$comment: Every construct of XSD 1.0 and how the generator treats it. handled: what reads it, through the schema library - the instance oracle proves the fact it writes. excluded: why, and what it changes in an instance (nothing, or what another handled fact already says). xsd-1.1: refused by the XSD 1.0 schema library at load, with every attribute of an element listed there; or a conditional inclusion (`*@vc:`) the library applies and libxml2 ignores, so the two do not read the same schema. A construct in none of the three fails the proof (python/proof/constructs.py). Rows are added in review, never by a run.

handled.schema: model/read_schema.py - the schema loaded through the library, every global of its maps walked
handled.schema@targetNamespace: model/read_schema.py - the namespace of every global, written on each element and particle
handled.schema@elementFormDefault: model/read_schema.py - the namespace of a local element (qualified or none)
handled.schema@attributeFormDefault: model/read_schema.py - the namespace of a local attribute, its key prefixed when it has one
handled.schema@blockDefault: model/read_schema.py - the derivations an element blocks when it says none: xsi:type variants and substitution members
handled.include: model/read_schema.py - a document of the same namespace, read with the entry (local only)
handled.import: model/read_schema.py - a document of another namespace, read with the entry (local only)
handled.import@namespace: model/read_schema.py - the namespace the imported document declares
handled.redefine: model/datatypes.py, model/wildcards.py - a redefined type continues into the one it redefines, a redefined attribute group's self-reference is the group it redefines
handled.annotation: model/read_schema.py - holds the documentation of an element declaration
handled.documentation: model/read_schema.py - an element declaration's documentation, written whole (markup included)
handled.element: model/read_schema.py - one declaration per element the content reaches, every global
handled.element@ref: model/read_schema.py - the global declaration a particle holds
handled.element@type: model/read_schema.py, model/datatypes.py - attributes, content model, text type of the declaration; its identity tells declarations apart
handled.element@abstract: model/read_schema.py - an abstract element is never an element of the dialecte, never in a content model
handled.element@substitutionGroup: model/read_schema.py - the members a particle naming the head holds, as a choice
handled.element@block: model/read_schema.py - xsi:type variants and substitution members leave out the blocked derivations; block=substitution leaves every member out
handled.element@form: model/read_schema.py - the namespace of a local element (qualified or none)
handled.attribute: model/read_schema.py - one attribute declaration per element declaration
handled.attribute@ref: model/read_schema.py - the global attribute declaration used
handled.attribute@use: model/read_schema.py - required; prohibited removes the attribute
handled.attribute@form: model/read_schema.py - the attribute's namespace, its key prefixed when it has one
handled.attributeGroup: model/read_schema.py - its attributes inlined where it is referenced
handled.attributeGroup@ref: model/read_schema.py, model/wildcards.py - its attributes and wildcard inlined
handled.anyAttribute: model/wildcards.py - attributes.any, computed per document along extensions and attribute groups
handled.anyAttribute@namespace: model/wildcards.py - namespace / notNamespace, relative to the declaring document
handled.complexType: model/read_schema.py - the content an element of that type holds; its identity tells declarations apart
handled.complexType@name: model/read_schema.py - the type's QName (TYPES key, variants)
handled.complexType@abstract: model/read_schema.py - abstractType; never an xsi:type variant
handled.complexType@block: model/read_schema.py - the derivations a declaration of that type blocks: xsi:type variants and substitution members
handled.simpleContent: model/datatypes.py - the text type of the element
handled.extension: model/read_schema.py, model/datatypes.py, model/wildcards.py - base content then the extension's; text type of the base; wildcards united
handled.extension@base: model/read_schema.py - the type extended; a derivation step for xsi:type and substitution
handled.restriction: model/datatypes.py, model/read_schema.py - a datatype level with its facets; a restricted content model
handled.restriction@base: model/datatypes.py, model/read_schema.py - the type restricted; a derivation step
handled.simpleType@name: model/datatypes.py - the type's QName (TYPES key, variants)
handled.union: model/datatypes.py - { union: members } in memberTypes then inline order
handled.length: model/datatypes.py - facets.length (item count on a list)
handled.pattern: model/datatypes.py, definition/patterns.py - facets.pattern, one level per restriction, written as JS
handled.pattern@value: definition/patterns.py - the XSD regular expression converted
handled.enumeration: model/datatypes.py - facets.enumeration of the most derived level declaring one
handled.enumeration@value: model/datatypes.py - lexical, white space normalized as the type does, QName as {uri}local
handled.whiteSpace: model/datatypes.py - facets.whiteSpace when it is not the built-in's
handled.group: model/read_schema.py - its particle inlined where it is referenced
handled.group@ref: model/read_schema.py - its particle, with the referencing occurrence
handled.group@minOccurs: model/read_schema.py - the occurrence of the referenced particle
handled.group@maxOccurs: model/read_schema.py - the occurrence of the referenced particle
handled.any@namespace: model/wildcards.py - namespace / notNamespace, relative to the declaring document
handled.unique: model/identity_paths.py - a constraint on the declaration
handled.unique@name: model/identity_paths.py - its QName; tells declarations apart
handled.key: model/identity_paths.py - a constraint on the declaration
handled.key@name: model/identity_paths.py - its QName; tells declarations apart
handled.keyref: model/identity_paths.py - a constraint on the declaration
handled.keyref@name: model/identity_paths.py - its QName; tells declarations apart
handled.selector@xpath: model/identity_paths.py - parsed over the XSD 1.0 grammar, prefixes in scope
handled.field: model/identity_paths.py - one field, a union of paths
handled.field@xpath: model/identity_paths.py - parsed over the XSD 1.0 grammar, prefixes in scope
